theme.event_line: THE GOOD LIFE · MEN · YOUNG MEN · MEANINGFUL CONNECTIONS

steps.title: What Really Matters for Men and Young Men?
steps.subtitle: An intergenerational conversation about happiness, relationships, future choices, legacy, and living with fewer regrets.

presenter.talking_point: Introduce the intergenerational conversation and invite everyone to answer from where they are in life today.

steps.title: What makes a good life?
steps.subtitle: Robert Waldinger · Harvard Study of Adult Development

presenter.talking_point: Adult Men: What has experience taught you? Students: What kind of life are you building? Listen for one idea that challenges how you define success.

steps.title: Same room. Different life stages. Every voice counts.
steps.subtitle: Select one answer. Personal explanations are optional.
